fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Seller Center API key (Mi Cuenta > Integraciones / API in Falabella Seller Center). Signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over the name-sorted, RFC 3986-encoded query, sent as the Signature parameter); never sent on the wire.

config_fields.name: user_id
config_fields.help: Seller Center UserID: the e-mail login the API key belongs to (sent as UserID).

config_fields.name: operator_code
config_fields.help: Business unit to write to: facl (Chile), fape (Peru) or faco (Colombia).

config_fields.name: warehouse_id
config_fields.help: SellerWarehouseId for set_inventory when the seller has several warehouses (GetWarehouse); leave empty with a single warehouse.

adapter.terms: Falabella Seller Center API (sellercenter-api.falabella.com): every call carries Action, Format, Timestamp, UserID and Version as query parameters, sorted by name and signed with the API key. Writes (ProductUpdate, ProductRemove, UpdateStock) are asynchronous feeds: the answer is a RequestId, and the outcome is read later with FeedStatus in Seller Center. No sandbox; the portal recommends low-value test products.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists one product (GetProducts, Limit=1) to verify the UserID, API key and signature.

list_orders.note: GetOrders (XML answer, values are strings; the order's item statuses and the Price total stay under raw.Statuses / raw.Price because an order can carry several item statuses). `since` is sent as CreatedAfter (ISO 8601); `status` is an order status code such as pending, ready_to_ship, shipped, delivered, canceled (comma-separated for several). Parameters are listed in name order because the signature covers the sorted query. Shipping an order (SetStatusToReadyToShip) needs order-item ids from GetOrderItems.

update_listing.note: ProductUpdate feed keyed by SellerSku (listing_id = your SellerSku) for the configured business unit (facl/fape/faco): only the fields you pass are changed (Name, Description, Price, Stock). Asynchronous: the answer is a feed RequestId; check FeedStatus in Seller Center for rejections.

set_inventory.note: UpdateStock for one SellerSku (`sku` is required; it is your SellerSku) in the default warehouse, or in the configured SellerWarehouseId. Not for Fulfillment-by-Falabella stock. Asynchronous feed (RequestId).

end_listing.note: ProductRemove feed for one SellerSku (listing_id). A removed product can be restored with ProductUpdate and the Status tag (per the docs). Asynchronous feed (RequestId).

not_offered.create_listing: ProductCreate (https://developers.falabella.com/docs/products/productcreate) requires Brand, PrimaryCategory, the category's mandatory ProductData attributes (ConditionType, PackageHeight/Width/Length/Weight, TaxPercentage in Colombia) and a Variation group; the vocabulary carries none of them.
not_offered.mark_shipped: SetStatusToReadyToShip (https://developers.falabella.com/docs/orders/setstatustoreadytoship) takes "OrderItemIds=[1,2,3]" and a PackageId, not an order id, and the carrier/tracking come from Falabella's label; order-item ids are not a vocabulary input.
